summary.project_title: RoadVision AI – Intelligent Road Condition Classification System for Indian Roads
summary.academic_course: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AIML) – Civil Engineering Mini Project (CO3 & CO4)

features.name: Roughness Index (IRI)
features.description: International Roughness Index measured via bump integrator / laser profiler per IRC:SP:16 guidelines.

features.name: Crack Percentage
features.description: Cumulative alligator, longitudinal, and transverse cracked surface area per 500m segment.

features.name: Rutting Depth
features.description: Permanent longitudinal depressions along wheel paths under repeated commercial vehicle axle loading.

features.name: Pavement Surface Age
features.description: Time elapsed since last asphalt bituminous overlay or initial new highway construction.

features.name: Pothole Count
features.description: Frequency of structural bowl-shaped pavement cavities exceeding 25mm depth and 150mm diameter.

features.name: Drainage Condition
features.description: Adequacy of side longitudinal storm drains, cross culverts, and shoulder cross-slope runoff.

features.name: Traffic Volume (AADT)
features.description: Average Annual Daily Traffic volume contributing to cumulative Equivalent Single Axle Loads (ESAL).
